response.client_rating_basis: client.rating is the average score FREELANCERS gave this client after working with them (total_reviews is how many rated them), not the client's rating of freelancers and not a measure of the client's own success. A low rating is other freelancers reporting a bad experience with this client — surface it when the user is deciding whether to apply.
